Alright. Voat looks like they're using the gitflow style of development, where they have a master branch with the stable version of the software and feature branches where they are working on various features. API_BASE_MERGE is a feature branch where they are working on some sort of API changes. They've been working on these changes for ~7 months now and have not finished these changes. Once they finish these API changes they will commit the branch to master.

Usually with gitflow you'd see smaller changes also in their own feature branches, like the robots.txt change I mentioned in my other comment. These small changes would get committed to master. However, voat isn't doing this, they're just committing all changes into the feature branch. This is probably because they're running the website off of the feature branch, so it's basically become the new master. They were probably originally intending to do a gitflow feature branch, then immediately wanted the changes from that branch so they switched to running the server off that branch, then started committing everything to that branch so it would get committed to the server.
